name: Sprut
summary: Sprut is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using moving average crossovers and momentum confirmation, entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It employs trailing stop mechanisms to protect profits and uses fixed lot sizing with optional risk-based position sizing. The EA is designed for medium-to-long-term trading on major currency pairs.
summary_zh: Sprut是一个趋势跟踪型EA，通过均线交叉和动量确认来识别市场方向，沿主导趋势方向入场交易。它采用移动止损机制保护利润，并使用固定手数或基于风险的仓位管理。该EA适用于主要货币对的中长期交易。
strategy_analysis: Sprut EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过移动平均线的交叉来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件通常包括快均线上穿或下穿慢均线，同时结合动量指标（如RSI或MACD）进行确认，以避免假突破。出场条件采用移动止损（Trailing Stop）机制，当价格朝有利方向移动时动态调整止损位锁定利润，同时也设置了固定止盈目标。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，也可根据账户余额和风险比例自动计算交易手数。资金管理上，EA包含最大持仓限制和账户权益保护机制，防止单次交易或连续亏损对账户造成过大损害。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺乏对市场震荡行情的过滤机制，可能在横盘市场中产生较多虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Sprut EA is trend following, using moving average crossovers to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions typically include a fast moving average crossing above or below a slow moving average, combined with momentum indicator confirmation (such as RSI or MACD) to avoid false breakouts. Exit conditions employ a trailing stop mechanism that dynamically adjusts the stop loss level as price moves favorably to lock in profits, along with fixed take profit targets. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and can also automatically calculate lot size based on account balance and risk percentage. Money management includes maximum position limits and account equity protection mechanisms to prevent excessive damage from a single trade or consecutive losses. The overall strategy logic is clear, but lacks filtering mechanisms for range-bound markets, which may generate many false signals during sideways consolidation periods.
pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，在明确趋势行情中表现良好
采用移动止损机制有效保护利润，降低回撤风险
包含动量确认过滤，减少假突破导致的亏损交易
支持固定手数和风险比例两种仓位管理模式，灵活度高
设有最大持仓限制，防止单一方向过度暴露风险
pros_en: Clear trend-following strategy logic that performs well in strong trending markets
Trailing stop mechanism effectively protects profits and reduces drawdown risk
Momentum confirmation filter reduces losing trades from false breakouts
Supports both fixed lot and risk-percentage position sizing for flexibility
Maximum position limits prevent excessive directional exposure risk
cons: 缺乏横盘震荡市场的识别和过滤机制，容易在盘整期频繁开仓亏损
均线交叉信号存在固有滞后性，可能错过趋势初期的最佳入场点
未包含点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下交易成本可能侵蚀利润
止损和止盈参数为固定点数，未根据市场波动率（ATR）动态调整
缺少多时间周期确认，单一周期信号可靠性有限
cons_en: Lacks range-bound market identification and filtering, prone to frequent losing trades during consolidation
Moving average crossover signals have inherent lag, potentially missing optimal trend entry points
No spread filter included, trading costs may erode profits in high-spread environments
Stop loss and take profit use fixed pip values without dynamic ATR-based adjustment
Missing multi-timeframe confirmation, single timeframe signal reliability is limited
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在横盘市场时暂停交易以避免虚假信号
将止损止盈参数改为基于ATR的动态计算，适应不同市场波动环境
增加多时间周期确认机制，例如H4趋势方向配合H1入场信号提高胜率
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to pause trading during range-bound markets and avoid false signals
Convert stop loss and take profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to varying market volatility
Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., H4 trend direction with H1 entry signal to improve win rate

risk_points: 均线交叉信号的滞后性可能导致入场时机偏晚，增加回撤风险
固定点数止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，极端行情下可能不够用
缺少横盘过滤机制，震荡行情中可能产生连续亏损
risk_points_en: Lag inherent in MA crossover signals may cause late entries, increasing drawdown risk
Fixed pip stop loss/take profit doesn't account for volatility changes, may be inadequate in extreme markets
No range filter mechanism may lead to consecutive losses during choppy consolidation periods
